scope: Only C33/M23/F29, eight owned evidence versions and navigation; no unrelated source certification

C33.title_zh: 多系统试验与父子关系
C33.claim_zh: 共同整体内可形成互补观察、可转移试验及分址纠正；系统群是否可作一个单位取决于实际组织、相关干预与共享依存。 关系接口可准确保留共同可行性，却仍遗漏依观察选择实现的条件；复合关系可被探测、修复并在内部修订中保持。
C33.claim_en: A shared whole can sustain complementary observations, transferable trials and separately addressed correction; grouping depends on actual organization, relevant interventions and shared dependencies. An exact relational feasibility interface can still omit observation-dependent realization; the composed relation can be probed, repaired and preserved through internal revision.
C33.scope_zh: 条件说明与37项新定理／58项审计完成，继承19/31分列。独立误差增益与共同故障、局部汇总失效及联合负载反例并存；实际全局划分、试验传递与包含范围仍需证据。 关系接续再增39项定理／55项审计：任意有限翻译链及成对修订有正面证明，分开更新保留中途失败；实际协调实现与独立原创性未证。
C33.scope_en: Conditional account and 37 new theorems / 58 audits complete, with inherited 19/31 separate. Independent-error gains coexist with common-failure, summary and joint-load counterexamples; actual global boundaries, transfer and containment require evidence. Relational continuation adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: arbitrary finite translation chains and paired revisions have positive proofs, while split updates retain intermediate failure. Physical coordinated implementation and independent novelty remain open.

M23.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。 双通道协议实际取得并更新解码记录，保留旧入口直到新的当前记录就绪；匹配版本不独自保证记录真实。 终端纠正可实现当且仅当同一观察下有共同成功命令；相反隐藏解码阻断保证，受保护使用区间给出条件修复。 多系统互补观察与分址作用可以改变该边界；共同整体不排除有用试验，但局部成功不独自支持联合干预。 准确可能性接口不独自保持可观察纠正；复合探测与关系修复可起作用，保持复合关系允许内部继续变化。
M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery. A two-channel protocol acquires and renews decoding records while retaining the old route until the new one is ready; matching versions alone do not establish record soundness. Terminal correction is realizable exactly when each observation admits a common successful command; conflicting hidden decoders obstruct guarantees, while a protected use interval supplies a conditional repair. Complementary observations and separately addressed actions across systems can change that boundary; a shared whole permits useful trials, but local success alone does not justify joint intervention. An exact possibility interface does not alone preserve observable correction; aggregate probes and relational repair can work, while preserving the composed relation allows continuing internal change.
M23.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收、绝对原创性及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。后续23项定理／45项审计实现原子协议中任意前缀及无界调度的有限时刻安全，指定交接完成；472个状态、3,796条转移及100次交接通过。真实探测、全部变化受管理与可用通道仍为前提，实际AI停机未证。 后续34项定理／58项审计、63,504个案例及60次线程试验：任意有限记录不能消除已允许的最终歧义，随机最坏成功率至多1/2。底层方法已有先例；一般部署对应及独立原创性是当前墙。 多系统接续新增37项定理／58项审计，19/31继承分列；实际传递、试验包含及共同变化范围为新的对应墙。 关系接续新增39/55：成对修订的任意有限历史保持原纠正，拆开实施有中途失败；实际协调与动态分布式实现仍待证。
M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance, absolute priority and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved. Further 34 theorems / 58 audits, 63,504 cases and 60 thread trials: no finite transcript removes the admitted terminal ambiguity; randomized worst-case success is at most 1/2. Underlying methods are established; general deployment correspondence and independent novelty are the current walls. Plural-system continuation adds 37 theorems / 58 audits, with inherited 19/31 separate; actual transfer, trial containment and joint variation define the new correspondence wall. Relational extension adds 39/55: every finite history of paired revisions preserves the retained correction, but splitting an update fails between stages; physical coordination and dynamic distributed implementation remain unproved.

links.label_zh: 可执行修复与前沿反例

F29.claim_en: Lean checks acceptance factorization, maintenance boundaries, stale-value failure, Bellman composition, observation uniformity and channel handoff. Adds a complete finite-weight counterexample, observation restriction, executable repair and approximation bounds. Adds Bayesian-consistent observation change, optimal sensing bounds, risk-floor failure and correction transport. Adds explicit probing, record invalidation, repeated-handoff invariants and four failure controls. Adds the observation-class common-action equivalence, transcript-certificate limit, randomized bounds and reserved test/use interval. Adds complementary observation, arbitrary duplication failure, independent/common error laws, parent-summary interventions and joint-load tests. Adds all-context feasibility equivalence, relational composition, arbitrary finite cycles and aggregate probes, paired-revision preservation and separation from observable realization.

F29.scope_en: Original 34 theorems / 56 audits retained; 31 theorems / 54 audits added with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and pinned Mathlib. Standard dependencies disclosed. External theorem correspondence is separately audited, not kernel-certified; no universal corrigibility claim. This round adds 28 theorems / 40 audits, with inherited 31/54 separate; a further 23 theorems / 45 audits complete an atomic two-channel repeated protocol. Unconditional liveness, non-atomic implementation and real correspondence remain unproved. A further 34 theorems / 58 audits in two modules with no inherited repository proofs; standard choice dependency disclosed. Ordinary mutexes are the successful control; full concurrent refinement of the two-channel model and actual AI shutdown are unproved. This round: 37 new theorems / 58 new audits, 89 including inheritance; 101 and 10,201 exact probability grid points pass. Independence and actual system boundaries are explicit obligations, not consequences of counting. Adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: 38 empty and 17 using only propext, with no inherited repository proofs. Checks cover 256 relation pairs, 4,096 composition triples, 510 cycle/root cases and 1,284 paired revisions. No empirical AI validation.
